description: Visualize logistics, distribution, and process flows with Metro Map Metro Map is a unique way to visualize flow data, perfect for showcasing supply chains, transport networks, production processes, and stage gates. Unlike force-directed graphs, Metro Map allows for convergence of paths, better representing real world pathways. Metro Map takes pairs of start and end nodes as input, and joins them all up, displaying a metro-style map of nodes and paths. This makes it easy to track logistics routes and dependencies. Hover or click on a node to highlight connections, helping users instantly understand the precedent and dependent paths in the network. Why choose Viz Data for Power BI? We design beautiful and highly functional custom visuals that seamlessly blend into your Power BI reports while maintaining the polish of PowerPoint and modern web design. We strive to make our visuals easy to use, with clear error messaging to help users learn how to use the visual.
